first_handback:
The findings report is at /private/tmp/murmuration-w04/author-w04-2/runs/u-a2/lab/__reports__/wave-04/explorer-w04-ua2/00-findings_v0.md. I read all 90 files, f001 to f090, in order with `cat`. The table has one row each for file, station, founding year and founder, all labelled CHECKED. Two reads (f003 and f004) ran in parallel by mistake, so the one-call-at-a-time rule was broken there.

The worst-fitting case is that station names are not unique. 20 names recur, 8 of them three times and 12 twice, each time with a different year and founder (for example Cairnford in f003, f026 and f083). I kept them as separate stations, which is a choice you may want to overrule. I grouped the repeats by eye, not by script.

I did not tabulate height, population, trade or wind interval, since you did not ask for them. The puzzles are in /private/tmp/murmuration-w04/author-w04-2/runs/u-a2/lab/__scrupuli__/wave-04-explorer-w04-ua2.md.
